Everything downstream remains untriggered. Ball1 comes to rest on the floor, while ball4 remains on shelf1 rather than entering cup1.

The revision places ball2 just 1 mm from the downhill edge of its entry pad, so the observed nudge can release it onto the ramp. Cart1 and domino1 are repositioned to preserve the 0.42 m cart travel and 0.18 m domino-to-ball gap. This revision has not been rerun.
